content: Moderation console design: Pinterest Pinqueue3.0 splits the review page into review widgets (the evidence) and one action widget (the decision), with hotkeys and item-passing shared across every queue type. Crucially the reviewed unit is a bundle of related objects, not one record - for a reported Pin: the Pin, its owner, the board and the reporter; for a merchant: the merchant plus its recent Pins and boards. Queues are prioritised by severity and reach. Reviewers see model predictions alongside context, then pick a violation category or 'no violation'.
